checks: Capture bytes SHA-256 and ECDSA P-256 signature
Device and independent reference instrument serial identity
Calibration digest and distinct declared reference/device roots
Reported response difference compared to declared tolerance
Response observation, alarm issuance, acknowledgement chronology and delay bounds
Duplicate capture and alarm replay checks
Four separate missing original physical-evidence/authentication gates
limits: Software-supplied millivalue measurements do not prove sensor responses
Alarm issued/acknowledged state is a signed-or-declared event, not proof that a physical alarm sounded
Calibration digest and distinct root names are not independent calibration or ancestry proof
Synthetic trust flags do not grant operational ACT
Rust CI run success is unverified until GitHub Actions confirms it
